story_summary: GW中にラーメン遠征を満喫したぽんが、土曜日にもう一杯行こうとするが、体重計という現実に直面する。

panels.scene: 土曜の朝、ぽんが自宅のソファでスマホを見ながらGW中に巡ったラーメン店の写真を振り返っている。背景にカレンダー（5月）と窓の外に新緑。テーブルの上にラーメン店のスタンプカードが散乱。
panels.pon_expression: 満足げにニヤニヤ、頬に手を当てて幸せそう
panels.dialogue: GW5日間で8杯…最高の連休だった…✨
panels.chatgpt_prompt: watercolor anime style, soft warm colors, manga panel border, clean line art. Japanese office lady in her early 20s, short black bob hair with a small ahoge, big brown eyes, wearing a casual light pink t-shirt and grey sweatpants (weekend clothes). She is sitting on a cozy sofa looking at her smartphone with a blissful dreamy smile, one hand on her cheek. On the coffee table, several ramen shop stamp cards are scattered. A May calendar on the wall, fresh green leaves visible through the window, late spring morning light. 4-panel manga, panel 1 of 4

panels.scene: ぽんがスマホで地図アプリを開き、「今日も休みだし、隣の県の有名店に遠征しよう！」とやる気満々で立ち上がっている。窓の外は晴れた春の空。
panels.pon_expression: 目をキラキラさせて拳を握り、立ち上がるポーズ
panels.dialogue:
せっかくの土曜だし！
隣町の新店に遠征するぞ〜！🍜
panels.chatgpt_prompt: watercolor anime style, soft warm colors, manga panel border, clean line art. Japanese office lady in her early 20s, short black bob hair with a small ahoge, big brown eyes, wearing a casual light pink t-shirt and grey sweatpants. She is standing up energetically from the sofa with sparkling eyes and a pumped fist, holding her smartphone showing a map app in the other hand. Bright sunny spring sky visible through the window, fresh green trees outside. Energetic and excited pose. 4-panel manga, panel 2 of 4

panels.scene: 着替えようとして洗面所に行ったぽんが、ふと目に入った体重計に乗ってしまう。体重計の数字を見て、真顔で固まっている。背景に洗面所の鏡。
panels.pon_expression: 真顔で硬直、目が点になっている、顔が青ざめている
panels.chatgpt_prompt: watercolor anime style, soft warm colors, manga panel border, clean line art. Japanese office lady in her early 20s, short black bob hair with a small ahoge, big brown eyes, wearing a casual light pink t-shirt and grey sweatpants. She is standing on a bathroom scale in the washroom, staring down at it with a completely frozen blank expression, face turning pale, eyes as dots. A bathroom mirror behind her. Dramatic shadow over her face. Comedic shock moment. 4-panel manga, panel 3 of 4

panels.scene: 結局、隣町のラーメン店の前に並んでいるぽん。行列の中でスマホを見ながら「明日からダイエット」と呟いている。背景に春の青空と新緑の街路樹、人気店の長い行列。
panels.pon_expression: 若干の罪悪感を滲ませつつも、結局ワクワクが勝っている笑顔
panels.dialogue:
ま…まあ今日食べた分は
明日から走って返せばいいし…！
（走らない）
panels.chatgpt_prompt: watercolor anime style, soft warm colors, manga panel border, clean line art. Japanese office lady in her early 20s, short black bob hair with a small ahoge, big brown eyes, now wearing a light blue button-up shirt and dark navy slacks. She is standing in a long queue outside a popular ramen shop, holding her smartphone with a slightly guilty but mostly excited smile, sweat drop on her forehead. Spring blue sky, fresh green street trees lining the road, other people in the queue. A small narration text at the bottom saying she won't actually run. Comedic ending. 4-panel manga, panel 4 of 4
